verdict.rationale: Linear ships a built-in Linear Agent. Users can mention it ("@Linear can you take a stab at this?"), delegate issues and track the resulting coding sessions under My Issues → Assigned. The agent writes code via Claude Code or Codex in cloud sessions, then sets up, runs and tests its work before returning it. It also drafts updates with "Write with Agent", edits text, develops project ideas, and runs recurring Loops on a schedule or in response to events. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation to Linear Agent works as claimed, since all evidence is vendor changelog and marketing copy.
